picks.title: Adobe MAX 2026 Premiere updates: Color Mode, MCP
picks.rationale: The movies section's one Premiere-specific Adobe MAX item (per cross-section assignment): Color Mode ships out of beta in Premiere 27 and MCP will let third-party agents edit native project files in 2027. Changes editors' grading and automation workflows now. Kept over PVC 'Premiere 27 with Color Mode' and the No Film School MCP/mobile posts (same cluster c12).
picks.excerpt: Premiere's Color Mode leaves beta at Adobe MAX 2026, while MCP will let third-party agents edit native project files in 2027.

picks.title: Avid's Ready to Play brings AI video generation directly into Media Composer
picks.rationale: New tool release: Avid's Gemini/Veo-powered extension puts generative video inside Media Composer, the editing system most feature and TV editors use. It is a direct workflow change for professional editors.
picks.excerpt: Avid has announced Ready to Play, a new AI-powered extension for Media Composer built in partnership with Google Cloud and powered by Google's Gemini and Veo

picks.title: Webby Awards Launches IMDB-Like Credits Platform to Provide Verified Recognition for Creators Amid AI Growth (Exclusive)
picks.rationale: New launch: a verified human-credits registry, with Shonda Rhimes and Adam Scott among its founding members, set up as provenance infrastructure against AI-blurred authorship. It is a new mechanism that creators can claim their work in, not commentary.
picks.excerpt: The long-running initiative celebrating the best of the internet will allow winners, nominees and other honored individuals to claim their work, with Shonda Rhimes and Adam Scott among the founding members.

picks.title: AI Account Rips Off Animated Short To Promote Filmmaking Classes
picks.rationale: Fresh copyright flashpoint: an unauthorized 30-second AI remake of Patricio Plaza's hand-drawn 2008 short 'El empleo' reached millions of views to sell AI filmmaking classes, and the filmmaker responds on record. This is a concrete case of AI knockoffs of animated work.
picks.excerpt: Filmmaker Patricio Plaza responds after a 30-second AI knockoff of his hand-drawn 2008 classic attracts millions of views and sparks a copyright dispute.

picks.title: Tilly Norwood Creator's New Project? An AI Talking-Dog Movie With the Co-Director of 'The Lion King' (Video)
picks.rationale: Follow-up to the 09-26 Variety card ('Minkoff in talks' on Particle 6's 'Storm Dogs'): Minkoff is now confirmed on board, the first trailer has been released, and the project is being pitched for a studio release. It tests whether studios will distribute an AI-made film.
picks.excerpt: Rob Minkoff is on board, and the project is aiming for a studio release. Will they touch it?

https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies.new_action: Rob Minkoff confirmed on board (09-26 card reported only talks), and the first 'Storm Dogs' trailer was released (THR title '(Video)', slug 'watch-trailer'). The project is now being pitched for a studio release.

dedup.note: RE-CHECK 11-11: the THR Tilly Norwood/'Storm Dogs' pick is the same project as movies' 09-26 Variety card ('Minkoff in talks to join Particle 6 AI film Storm Dogs'). It is kept as a FOLLOW-UP because the excerpt and URL show new concrete actions: Minkoff is confirmed 'on board' (was 'in talks') and the first trailer has been released. Yonhap Kakao x OpenAI '그래도, 라이언' is still held back: from the excerpts I could not rule out that it is the same story as marketing's 11-10 news1 Kakao card. Dropped as duplicates: PVC 'Adobe ships Premiere 27 with Color Mode', No Film School 'Local MCP Integrations' and 'Firefly and Premiere mobile' (all cluster c12, same Premiere/MAX story as the RedShark pick); No Film School 'Adobe MAX 2026: What's New for Filmmakers' and The Verge 'Adobe is going all in on agentic AI' (Adobe MAX umbrella belongs to design per the 11-11 brief); Variety Weta FX 'Hollywood Has Flipped on GenAI' (interview follow-up to the 11-05 Weta FX/TAICCA card, no new event); Variety Grimes cameo in 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' (film already carded 10-26 AFM and earlier, extra reporting only); AWN CAA/Ogilvy ECHO (published in marketing 11-10 via Digiday, and 11-10 movies swapped it out for that reason). Excluded on scope: 80 Level Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview (games only per brief); THR David Ellison and TheWrap Kane Parsons (exec/artist opinion, no event); Deadline Flawless IP sale (business noise, 10-30); Variety AFM Innovation Hub (market programming); PVC Professional Sound Alliance (advocacy group formed; AI incidental in the excerpt); Korea Times KR-CN filmmakers (feature interview); Motionographer DREAMCAT (AI incidental); Theoretically Media 'Planet Hell' workflow (the 11-09 enrichment pass already dropped it as OpenArt-sponsored); Runway 'When Video Becomes an Interface' (promo video, related to the 10-28 Runway Summit card).
